dischargeCriteria: A break over 14 calendar days without good reason voids the prescription (HeilM-RL § 16)
Therapist must interrupt and tell the prescriber if the goal looks unreachable (§ 16(5))
School support need requires review at suitable intervals, none named (KMK 1994)
The prescriber decides on a new prescription or on ending treatment (HeilM-RL § 16(5))
Six months with no new prescription opens a fresh Verordnungsfall (HeilM-RL § 7(1))
Ruling must fix a term of at most a year to check the directing was right (art 21, 047/17)
Ministry decides an appeal in second instance, on a commission it names (art 22, 047/17)
Health worsening so lessons cannot be followed triggers a review (RS law, art 96)
The school then decides to continue or interrupt schooling, with Ministry consent (RS art 96)
Duty to attend ends at 15; the director may allow schooling to 17 (RS law, art 74)
A non-definitive Conava ruling is reviewed ex officio at the term it set (art 18, 2004)
Also reviewed ex officio when the administration learns the situation has changed (art 18)
Family may ask for review after that term, or two years from the last valuation (art 18)
FAS cover of an insured member’s child ends at eighteen (Regolamento art 3 § 1, 2025)
No age limit if the DSI-appointed Collegio Medico finds permanent incapacity (art 3 § 1)
Students covered to twenty in secondary studies and twenty-six at university (art 3 § 1)
Statement names a review date of not more than 3 years, or a termination date (2023)
Support can be re-dimensioned or removed once the outcomes are reached (2023 process)
The Review Panel reviews the outcomes and the support the statement issued (2023)
A review may be asked only a year after the Statement of Support was issued (2023)
Where an end-of-support date is set, review needs a change in circumstances (2023)

dischargeCriteria: A Record of Need ceases only if it is no longer necessary to maintain it (SEN CoP 7.86)
That includes a child no longer requiring the provision the RoN specifies (SEN CoP 7.87)
The Department decides to cease, after consulting parents and the setting (SEN CoP 7.90)
A 19-year-old leaving early keeps the RoN if they wish to return (SEN CoP 7.88)
The RoN may run to the end of the academic year in which they turn 19 (SEN CoP 7.91)
The Department may cancel the report itself or at a parent’s request (Act 2001 s 19(7))
A parent may appeal in writing against a proposal to cancel (reg 14, SD 433/04)
A fresh assessment on request is refused only if needs have not changed (Act Sch 4 para 2)
The centre’s conclusion records how long it is valid for (Polozhenie 2025, para 24)
Re-examination follows that term expiring or a change of route (Polozhenie 2025, para 26)
The centre’s director signs the conclusion, the PMPK chair the protocol (Polozhenie 25)

dischargeCriteria: Needs and the measures in place are re-evaluated at a periodicity fitting the case (art 47)
The commission médico-pédagogique carries out that evaluation (loi 1.334 art 47)
Its proposals go to the director of Éducation nationale, who rules (loi 1.334 art 25)
Schooling is compulsory from six until sixteen years complete (loi 1.334 art 3)

dischargeCriteria: Panel must keep the progress of every child referred under review (ETA s 47B(2)(c))
The panel advises the Director on the education of such a child (ETA s 47B(2)(b))
A pupil is over compulsory school age on attaining sixteen (ETA s 49(1))
Over-16s under nineteen may choose to remain in full-time education (ETA s 19(b)(ii))
Support-measure goals re-assessed within two years (functional assessment rulebook art 29)
The pupil's inclusive team runs to the end of basic education (ZOO art 16(3))
Measures rest on the functional assessment team's finding and opinion (rulebook art 12)
Measures reach children and youth with a health condition up to 26 (rulebook art 1)

dischargeCriteria: PEI team meets at least once a semester to revise and update the plan (CMI reg 683/2019)
A complex evaluation or re-evaluation report is laid before that meeting (CMI reg 683/2019)
The intraschool commission examines and approves changes to the PEI (CMI reg 683/2019)
The duty to attend compulsory education ends at sixteen (Codul educatiei art 13(2))
Ambulatory or specialised schooling ends on the Centres' proposal (loi 20.7.2018 art 33)
Centres re-evaluate whether the provision still fits at twelve and at sixteen (art 31(2))
No fresh diagnosis where one was realised in the last three years (2018 law art 31(2))
The class council's orientation opinion backs it and the CNI confirms (art 33)
The CNI may order a re-evaluation of fit whenever it thinks necessary (2018 law art 31(1))
